planetary_targets.name: Shackleton Crater & Connecting Ridge
planetary_targets.geologic_setting: South Pole-Aitken (SPA) basin rim volatile trap. Characterized by 21-km diameter impact crater with permanently shadowed interior cold-traps (<40 K) bordered by elevated illumination peaks along the Connecting Ridge receiving >80% annual sunlight.

optical.name: LROC Narrow Angle Camera (NAC)
optical.description: Sub-meter orbital optical imagery capturing high-contrast shadow-delineated ridge lines and crater rim morphology.

sar.name: Mini-RF S-band SAR (CPR)
sar.description: Circular Polarization Ratio (CPR) radar backscatter mapping subsurface volumetric ice scattering and surface blockiness.

thermal.name: Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment
thermal.description: Cryogenic brightness temperature mapping resolving micro-cold traps capable of preserving volatile water ice at 40 K.

slope.name: LOLA Topographic Slope Model
slope.description: Digital elevation model derived slope gradients identifying navigable 8° ridge saddles vs hazardous 32° inner wall scarps.

planetary_targets.name: Jezero Crater Margin & Nili Fossae
planetary_targets.geologic_setting: Western Isidis Planitia impact basin margin. Features an ancient Noachian/Hesperian fluvio-lacustrine open-basin lake fed by Neretva and Sava Valles, with a preserved smectite- and Mg-carbonate-bearing river delta scarp.

optical.name: HiRISE High-Resolution Imaging
optical.description: Ultra-high resolution optical imaging resolving decimeter-scale delta bottomset/foreset bedding and inverted paleochannels.

sar.name: SHARAD Sounding Radar Roughness
sar.description: Decametric radar surface roughness and dielectric interface transitions between delta sandstones and basaltic floor unit.

thermal.name: THEMIS Nighttime Thermal Infrared
thermal.description: Apparent thermal inertia differentiating indurated deltaic sandstones and carbonates from loose sand and airfall dust.

slope.name: MOLA / HRSC High-Resolution Topography
slope.description: Topographic slope and elevation contours mapping delta scarp grades (12°–18°) and gentle crater floor traverse corridors.
